theorems.name: CLEANSE_FUNCTIONAL_PREFIX_READ
theorems.statement:
forall s p i.
    read (memory :> bytes (p,i)) s = 0 /\
    read (memory :> bytes8 (word_add p (word i))) s = word 0
    ==> read (memory :> bytes (p,i + 1)) s = 0

theorems.name: OPENSSL_CLEANSE_BYTE_LOOP
theorems.statement:
forall pc p n.
    0 < n /\ n < 2 EXP 64 /\ nonoverlapping (word pc,97) (p,n)
    ==> ensures x86
        (\s.
             bytes_loaded s (word pc) openssl_cleanse_mc /\
             read RIP s = word (pc + 19) /\
             read RDI s = p /\
             read RSI s = word n /\
             read RAX s = word 0)
        (\s.
             read RIP s = word (pc + 31) /\
             read RDI s = word_add p (word n) /\
             read RSI s = word 0 /\
             read RAX s = word 0 /\
             read (memory :> bytes (p,n)) s = 0)
        (MAYCHANGE [RIP; RDI; RSI] ,,
         MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
         MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes (p,n)] ,,
         MAYCHANGE [events])

theorems.name: CLEANSE_FUNCTIONAL_BULK_MASK
theorems.statement:
forall k.
    k < 2 EXP 64
    ==> (val (word_and (word k) (word 18446744073709551608)) = 0 <=> k < 8)

theorems.name: CLEANSE_FUNCTIONAL_LOW3
theorems.statement:
forall p i.
    val p + i < 2 EXP 64
    ==> val (word_and (word_add p (word i)) (word 7)) = (val p + i) MOD 8

theorems.name: OPENSSL_CLEANSE_ALIGNMENT
theorems.statement:
forall pc p n a.
    a < 8 /\
    a <= n /\
    n < 2 EXP 64 /\
    val p + a < 2 EXP 64 /\
    (val p + a) MOD 8 = 0 /\
    (forall i. i < a ==> ~((val p + i) MOD 8 = 0)) /\
    nonoverlapping (word pc,97) (p,a)
    ==> ensures x86
        (\s.
             bytes_loaded s (word pc) openssl_cleanse_mc /\
             read RIP s = word (pc + 48) /\
             read RDI s = p /\
             read RSI s = word n /\
             read RAX s = word 0)
        (\s.
             read RIP s = word (pc + 69) /\
             read RDI s = word_add p (word a) /\
             read RSI s = word (n - a) /\
             read RAX s = word 0 /\
             read (memory :> bytes (p,a)) s = 0)
        (MAYCHANGE [RIP; RDI; RSI] ,,
         MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
         MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes (p,a)] ,,
         MAYCHANGE [events])

theorems.name: CLEANSE_FUNCTIONAL_ALIGNMENT_COUNT
theorems.statement:
forall v.
    let a = (8 - v MOD 8) MOD 8 in
    a < 8 /\ (v + a) MOD 8 = 0 /\ (forall i. i < a ==> ~((v + i) MOD 8 = 0))

theorems.name: CLEANSE_REGIONS_DISJOINT_NONOVERLAPPING
theorems.statement:
forall p q n k.
    val p + n <= 2 EXP 64 /\
    val q + k <= 2 EXP 64 /\
    (forall a. ~(assurance_region p n a /\ assurance_region q k a))
    ==> nonoverlapping (p,n) (q,k)

theorems.name: CLEANSE_REGION_WORD_SUB
theorems.statement:
forall p a n.
    n < 2 EXP 64 /\ val p + n <= 2 EXP 64
    ==> (assurance_region p n (val a) <=> val (word_sub a p) < n)

theorems.name: CLEANSE_MEMORY_WRITE_BYTES_OUTSIDE
theorems.statement:
forall p a n x m.
    n < 2 EXP 64 /\ val p + n <= 2 EXP 64 /\ ~assurance_region p n (val a)
    ==> write (bytes (p,n)) x m a = m a

theorems.name: CLEANSE_STATE_WRITE_BYTES_OUTSIDE
theorems.statement:
forall p a n x s.
    n < 2 EXP 64 /\ val p + n <= 2 EXP 64 /\ ~assurance_region p n (val a)
    ==> read memory (write (memory :> bytes (p,n)) x s) a = read memory s a

theorems.name: CLEANSE_FUNCTIONAL_FRAME_OUTSIDE

forall p n s t a.
    n < 2 EXP 64 /\
    val p + n <= 2 EXP 64 /\
    (MAYCHANGE [RIP; RSP; RAX; RDI; RSI] ,,
     MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
     MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes (p,n)] ,,
     MAYCHANGE [events])
    s
    t /\
    ~assurance_region p n (val a)
    ==> read memory t a = read memory s a

theorems.name: BP_E2_CLEANSE_BOUNDED_FUNCTIONAL_RETURN
theorems.statement:
forall pc stackpointer ra p n m rp wp xp ordinary.
    ensures_n x86
    (bp_e2_cleanse_pre pc stackpointer ra p n m rp wp xp ordinary)
    (\s.
         read RIP s = ra /\
         val (read RSP s) = val stackpointer + 8 /\
         (forall i. i < n ==> read memory s (word_add p (word i)) = word 0) /\
         (forall a. ~assurance_region p n (val a) ==> read memory s a = m a))
    (MAYCHANGE [RIP; RSP; RAX; RDI; RSI] ,,
     MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
     MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes (p,n)] ,,
     MAYCHANGE [events])
    (\s. cleanse_functional_steps p n)

         val (read RSP s) = val stackpointer + 8 /\
         (forall i. i < n ==> read memory s (word_add p (word i)) = word 0) /\
         (forall a. ~assurance_region p n (val a) ==> read memory s a = m a))

     MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
     MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes (p,n)] ,,
     MAYCHANGE [events])

expanded_definitions.name: bp_e2_cleanse_pre
expanded_definitions.statement:
forall m ra s xp rp wp ordinary pc p n stackpointer.
    bp_e2_cleanse_pre pc stackpointer ra p n m rp wp xp ordinary s <=>
    n < 2 EXP 64 /\
    pc + 97 <= 2 EXP 64 /\
    bytes_loaded s (word pc) openssl_cleanse_mc /\
    read RIP s = word pc /\
    read RSP s = stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s = ra /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p; word n] s /\
    read memory s = m /\
    val stackpointer MOD 16 = 8 /\
    val stackpointer + 8 < 2 EXP 64 /\
    assurance_canonical48 (val ra) /\
    ~(ra = word pc) /\
    (read DF s <=> false) /\
    ~bit 18 (read rflags s) /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) pc 97 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer) 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. wp a /\ ordinary a) (val p) n /\
    (forall a. ~(assurance_region p n a /\ assurance_region (word pc) 97 a)) /\
    (forall a.
         ~(assurance_region p n a /\ assurance_region stackpointer 8 a))

expanded_definitions.name: bp_e2_cleanse_allowed_read
expanded_definitions.statement:
forall rp ordinary stackpointer a.
    bp_e2_cleanse_allowed_read rp ordinary stackpointer a <=>
    rp a /\ ordinary a /\ assurance_region stackpointer 8 a

expanded_definitions.name: bp_e2_cleanse_allowed_write
expanded_definitions.statement:
forall wp ordinary p n a.
    bp_e2_cleanse_allowed_write wp ordinary p n a <=>
    wp a /\ ordinary a /\ assurance_region p n a

expanded_definitions.name: bp_e2_cleanse_allowed_fetch
expanded_definitions.statement:
forall xp ordinary pc a.
    bp_e2_cleanse_allowed_fetch xp ordinary pc a <=>
    xp a /\ ordinary a /\ assurance_region (word pc) 97 a

expanded_definitions.name: cleanse_alignment_count
expanded_definitions.statement: forall p. cleanse_alignment_count p = (8 - val p MOD 8) MOD 8

expanded_definitions.name: cleanse_functional_steps
expanded_definitions.statement:
forall n p.
    cleanse_functional_steps p n =
    (if n < 15
     then 4 * n + 7
     else let a = (8 - val p MOD 8) MOD 8 in
          9 + 6 * a + 5 * (n - a) DIV 8 + 4 * (n - a) MOD 8)

expanded_definitions.name: assurance_region
expanded_definitions.statement: forall a p n. assurance_region p n a <=> val p <= a /\ a < val p + n

expanded_definitions.name: assurance_span_ok
expanded_definitions.statement:
forall width perm a.
    assurance_span_ok perm a width <=>
    a + width <= 2 EXP 64 /\
    (forall j. j < width ==> assurance_canonical48 (a + j) /\ perm (a + j))

expanded_definitions.name: assurance_canonical48
expanded_definitions.statement:
forall a.
    assurance_canonical48 a <=>
    a < 2 EXP 64 /\ (a < 2 EXP 47 \/ 2 EXP 64 - 2 EXP 47 <= a)
